Future<void> run(items, client, orders) async {
 var cursor = 0;
 Object? value;
 for (final item in items) {
  cursor = await advance(cursor, item);
  cursor = await advance(cursor,
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.get(item));
  value ??= await client.load();
  if (value == null) value = await client.load();
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  values[item] ??= await client.load();
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await orders.put(item);
 }
}
